title: Concept: Project dependency installed from git
description: pyproject.toml declares a PEP 508 git URL in `project.dependencies`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a PEP 508 git URL in `project.dependencies`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a PEP 508 git URL in `project.dependencies`.
